admin.footer: Operations console shipped with the community service: gateway path /admin/community, port 3000, health at /admin/community/api/health.
admin.session.title: Current identity
admin.session.signInHint: This console shares the site session: sign in on the site, then return to this page.
admin.denied.title: No access to this tab
admin.denied.body: Required permission codes: {codes}. Grant them in the account service's permission group, then sign in again.
admin.denied.serviceNote: The service still authorises independently; the UI just hides entries that would end in 403.
admin.boards.title: Board management
admin.boards.desc: Boards are seeded by the service; this page only configures them: four-locale names and descriptions, colour, icon, order, enablement and feed visibility.
admin.boards.codeNote: code anchors topic ownership and cannot change; creating or deleting boards is not offered either.
admin.boards.searchPlaceholder: Filter by code or any locale name
admin.boards.namesHint: Names are the board's identity: all four locales must be non-empty or the service returns 400 four_locale_names_required.
admin.boards.descriptionsHint: Descriptions are not identity: leave all four empty to clear them; filling only some is treated as missing locales.
admin.boards.feedHint: When off, this board's topics stay out of the site feed (the comment board is off).
admin.boards.colorCustom: Not in the suggested list; saved as-is
admin.boards.iconCustom: Not in the suggested icons; saved as-is
admin.boards.noChange: Nothing changed, so nothing was submitted.
admin.boards.namesRequired: Names cannot be empty in all four locales.
admin.boards.disableConfirm: Disabling {code} blocks new topics in that board (existing ones remain). Disable it?
admin.topics.title: Topic moderation
admin.topics.desc: List, search, pin and delete. Pinning needs community.topic.pin; deleting someone else's topic needs community.post.moderate.
admin.topics.commentNote: The comment board holds entity comments, not articles, so the topic list excludes it.
admin.topics.deleteConfirmBody: Deleting “{title}” also deletes all of its replies, irreversibly.
admin.posts.title: Post moderation
admin.posts.desc: Lists replies across topics (community.posts) with search over topic title or reply body, and per-row deletion; read-only, view counts untouched.
admin.posts.searchPlaceholder: Search topic title or reply body
admin.posts.deleteBody: Deleting the reply at floor {floor} cannot be undone, and the topic's reply count decreases by one.
admin.posts.commentsDesc: Entity comments live in the comment board and are served by /api/community/feed; it has no total/offset, so only the most recent matches are shown.
admin.posts.commentsSearchPlaceholder: Search comment body or entity title
admin.posts.commentsDeleteBody: Deleting this comment cannot be undone.
admin.err.unauthorized: Session expired or missing; please sign in again.
admin.err.forbidden: The current account lacks permission code {code}.
admin.err.notFound: The object does not exist or was deleted.
admin.err.invalidPayload: Invalid request: incomplete locale names, empty colour/icon, or a patch with no fields.
admin.err.module: Internal error in the community service; retry shortly.
admin.err.upstream: The community service is unreachable or returned {status}.
admin.err.fourLocales: Names/descriptions need all four locales; missing: {locales}.
